_notes: No time_bound candidates. Source code was not read; app.js references in candidates were checked only behaviourally. Contrast was measured by sampling probe screenshots (scratch script contrast.cjs using pngjs), not with uie audit, to avoid writing into the shared run.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced at 1280 (Monday 12) and 375 (Saturday 17): every 'Few left' slot is drawn in an unlabelled block above the 'Morning' heading, while the ARIA snapshot lists them chronologically under Morning/Afternoon.
verdicts.note: Visual order 08:20, 09:20, 12:00 ... above Morning; DOM order 08:00, 08:20 Few left, 08:40 ... under Morning.

verdicts.reason: not_reproduced: with Today's slots loaded and no slot chosen, focusing Next and pressing Enter shows a red alert 'Choose a slot first.' above the grid (role alert in the ARIA snapshot). Next is silent only while slots are still loading, which is covered by F-0032.
verdicts.note: Probe path: goto / -> wait .slot -> focus Next -> Enter -> wait 600 ms. The candidate's observation may come from activating Next during the load gap.

verdicts.reason: not_reproduced: the Steps list does mark the current step programmatically. [aria-label=Steps] [aria-current=step] exists on all three pages and contains '1. When', '2. Vehicle and waste' and '3. Check and book' respectively; a negative control ('2. Vehicle and waste' on /) failed as expected. The Playwright ARIA snapshot format simply does not print aria-current.
verdicts.note: Evidence-reading error: absence of a state in aria.yml is not absence of aria-current.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced with forcedColors active at 1280: after choosing Saturday 17 and 09:20, the pressed 'Saturday 17' differs from the other day buttons only by a marginally heavier black border; the chosen slot 09:20 is bold with a coloured border and stays distinct.
verdicts.note: Robustness observation as the candidate itself states; no WCAG failure claimed.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced with the keyboard: Tab onto the 'Today' day button shows a thick focus ring; tabbing on into the slot grid shows no focus indicator on any slot. Likewise, after Enter on Next with no slot, focus moves into the grid with no visible ring.
verdicts.note: Existence shown behaviourally; the injected-style mechanism was not inspected (no source access).

verdicts.reason: Reproduced at 320 px: the three-column slot grid is wider than the viewport; the right-hand column (12:00, 13:40, 09:00, 10:20 ...) is cut off at the right edge.
verdicts.note: Overflow amount not measured; the clipping is plain in the screenshot.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced: on first load and after choosing Saturday 17 the Slots area is blank for about 0.8-0.9 s with no loading text or indicator, and clicking Next during that gap produces no message.
verdicts.note: Overlaps F-0061 (same loading gap); the lead may merge them.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced: Today (Monday 12) offers 08:00 as free; booking it with all details filled shows, after the delay, the alert 'There is a problem' with 'The 08:00 slot today can no longer be booked. Choose another slot or day.'
verdicts.note: The error item itself has no link, but a 'Change slot' link is present in the Your booking summary on the same page; impact should reflect that. Cut-off time (10:35) not verified independently.

verdicts.reason: Measured from rendered pixels: light theme text rgb(189,125,15) on rgb(251,239,218) = 3.02:1; dark theme rgb(171,124,43) on rgb(60,50,32) = 3.38:1. Both below 4.5:1 for small bold text.
verdicts.corrected_description: The 'Few left' tag text uses an amber that is not DESIGN.md's warning token and renders at about 3.0:1 in light theme (#bd7d0f on #fbefda) and 3.4:1 in dark theme (#ab7c2b on #3c3220), below the 4.5:1 needed for its small bold text.
verdicts.note: Corrected the light ratio from ~2.7:1 to the measured 3.0:1. F-0085 reports the same element and mechanism.

verdicts.reason: The probe tool cannot generate IME composition events (isComposing), so an Enter that commits a candidate cannot be simulated; the claim rests on code reading only.
verdicts.note: Needs a manual test with a real IME (e.g. Japanese input) in the Your name field on /confirm.html.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced: right after page load #slots-status has no aria-live attribute (expect passed in 9 ms); the attribute appears only about 0.9 s later when the first slot count is rendered.
verdicts.corrected_description: #slots-status is not a live region at page load; aria-live is added only when the first slot count is written, so that first count is not reliably announced. Later updates happen in an existing live region.
verdicts.note: Not tested with a screen reader; the ordering of text write and attribute within the same task could not be observed.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced at 375 on Saturday 17: after tapping 09:20 (about y 1150) the only change is the slot's fill; Next sits about y 1740, below one more Morning row and five Afternoon rows, more than a viewport height (900) away, with nothing near the slot pointing to it.
verdicts.corrected_description: At 375 px, choosing 09:20 (about 1,150 px down the page) shows only a fill change; Next sits about 1,740 px down, below one more Morning row and five Afternoon rows, with nothing near the chosen slot pointing to it.
verdicts.note: Corrected 'four further rows of afternoon slots' to the observed rows.

verdicts.reason: Reproduced: 'Change slot' on Check and book (Saturday 17, 09:20) opens / headed 'Book a slot', step 1 bold, 'Today' pressed, Monday 12 slots listed; Saturday 17 and 09:20 are not preselected and nothing mentions the booking in progress.
verdicts.corrected_description: Activating 'Change slot' on Check and book opens the When page headed 'Book a slot' with 'Today' pressed and Today's slots shown (after the usual load gap); the previously chosen day and slot are not preselected and nothing says the vehicle, waste or entered details are kept.
verdicts.note: The Slots area is empty only during the ~0.9 s load, not persistently. Retention of entered details was not re-checked.

verdicts.reason: harness_artifact: with the pointer moved away after choosing Saturday 17, only 'Saturday 17' carries the selected tint; 'Tomorrow' is plain. The tint in captures comes from a hover state where the pointer rests (the same effect tints 08:20 in verifier-2/out2/step-10.png after the grid shifts under the pointer).

verdicts.reason: Both parts reproduce: after tapping Saturday 17 the Slots area is blank with no indicator, and during that gap the caption still reads 'Monday 12 October'. These are two problems; the first duplicates F-0032.

verdicts.note: Measured gap about 0.8-0.9 s, not 1.3 s. The lingering 'Choose a slot first.' error was not re-checked.

verdicts.reason: Absence confirmed by own search: the done page offers only the 'Book another slot' link and says 'If you cannot come, call 01632 960771 on a weekday'; footer gives weekdays 09:00 to 17:00.
